question: Which epithets characterize the goddess addressed in this invocation?
premises: The goddess Sarasvatī is directly addressed.
She is called ever-moist and flowing with love-juice.
inference: The invocation addresses Sarasvatī with the epithets five-voweled, ever-moist, and flowing with love-juice.
plain_english: O Sarasvatī, five-voweled one, ever-moist, flowing with the juice of passion.
